prepared_or_semantic_work_relocation.existing_k11: The current ELF also admits[3,11], moving a query in the opposite direction. It may rebalance after net savings, but worsens current stage1. No k11 run is claimed.
prepared_or_semantic_work_relocation.format_and_failure_changes: Must explicitly version the deferred-claim checkpoint meaning/slot (or remove32bytes), preserve genuine stage1/checkpoint custody, and prove pending checks before settlement. Parse/claim failures change transaction/error order. It is not an authorized extraction-only helper move.
prepared_or_semantic_work_relocation.prepared_claim: p.claim is only consumed by finish_relation in stage2. All pure claim inputs are in the bound proof plus gamma/kappa in the authenticated checkpoint; 174 EbyKDot pushes,6 finishes,29 gamma/7 kappa source powers and7 wide multiply/add terms can be relocated without changing Fiat–Shamir bytes.
prepared_or_semantic_work_relocation.semantic: Deferring round/terminal arithmetic while drawing the same transcript is possible only with new pending-check semantics. Original15 QM31 challenges (240B) are absent from today’s checkpoint, or re-derivation adds46 Digest32 calls plus15 samples and breaks ordered583 identity. Requires a separate protocol/checkpoint/proof decision.
